partition: Four complete unique sessions. First two sorted session IDs train; third calibrates the threshold using normal buckets only; fourth is held out. No held-out tuning.
label_policy: Administrator-like precursors are normal. Only the six allowlisted local/dummy risk simulations are positive. Labels describe simulations, not human identity or compromise.
collection_requirements: All 93 units complete, no event loss, exact raw/collector network counts. Optional socket metadata absence must be reconciled and reported, never treated as complete.
time_basis: Event and timeline CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds. Wall clock and file modification dates are not label inputs.
deployment: Candidate is offline only until evaluation and independent verification. Existing live model remains unchanged.
